en.subtitle: AI-powered multimodal scam and phishing threat analysis.
en.dashSubtitle: Analyze suspicious communications across text, images, audio and video with Gemini AI.
en.noDataDesc: Your personal threat detection center is ready. Paste a suspicious message, upload screenshots, or drop audio/video recordings to investigate.
en.featureMultimodalDesc: Combine multiple pieces of evidence (screenshots, voice calls, screen recordings, text) into a single cohesive investigation.
en.featureIntelligenceDesc: Understand the psychological tactics, fake domains, and urgency mechanisms scammers use to manipulate victims.
en.featureTrainingDesc: Practice recognizing realistic scam calls, phishing emails, and fake delivery texts in interactive simulations.
en.featurePrivacyDesc: Your investigation cases, evidence files, and analysis history are securely stored locally on this device.
en.analyzerSubtitle: Analyze suspicious messages, screenshots, audio, video, emails and other content using Gemini AI.
en.textInputPlaceholder: Paste suspicious message, phishing email headers, SMS content, fake website text, or conversation transcript here...
en.userNotesPlaceholder: Optional: add context (e.g. "Sent from unknown WhatsApp number claiming to be my bank manager")
en.dropImagesHere: Drag & drop screenshots or click to browse (PNG, JPG, WEBP)
en.dropAudioHere: Drag & drop voice note or call recording (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC)
en.dropVideoHere: Drag & drop screen recording or video (MP4, MOV, WEBM)
en.noEvidenceYet: No evidence attached yet. Add screenshots, audio, video, or paste text.
en.modeQuickScanDesc: Fast scam probability and threat indicator overview
en.modeDeepInvestigationDesc: Full multimodal cross-evidence correlation & forensic breakdown
en.modePhishingDesc: Focus on fake domains, credential harvesting, and spoofed brands
en.modeSocialEngineeringDesc: Analyze psychological manipulation, fear, urgency, and authority cues
en.modeFinancialDesc: Detect fake bank fees, crypto fraud, refund schemes, and OTP theft
en.modeCustomDesc: Focused analysis guided by your specific security concerns
en.riskScoreDisclaimer: This score is an AI-assisted risk assessment, not definitive legal proof of fraud.
en.emergencyBannerSubtitle: The evidence strongly matches active fraud patterns. Do NOT comply with any requested actions.
en.emergencyStopDesc: Do not send money, OTPs, passwords, or personal credentials.
en.emergencyProtectDesc: Freeze cards or change account credentials if information was already submitted.
en.emergencyVerifyDesc: Contact the organization directly via official bookmarked channels — never through provided links.
en.emergencyReportDesc: Report the scam message to your carrier, platform, or national cyber defense agency.
en.emergencyMonitorDesc: Check account statements and identity credit reports for unauthorized activity.
en.academySubtitle: Learn how cybercriminals manipulate emotions and practice making safe decisions in simulated situations.
en.realLifeDefenseLabel: What you should do in real life:
en.spotSubtitle: Test your threat detection instincts against realistic emails, SMS texts, and voice scripts.
en.knowledgeSubtitle: Comprehensive guide to modern social engineering, phishing vectors, and scam mechanics.
en.searchKnowledgePlaceholder: Search scam types (e.g. OTP, Bank, Crypto, Delivery, Romance)...
en.whatToDoIfCompromisedLabel: What to do if money/data was given
en.casesSubtitle: Manage your local incident dossiers, organize multi-file evidence, and review past verdicts.
en.noCasesFoundDesc: Start by analyzing a suspicious message or creating a case dossier.
en.historySubtitle: Review, search, filter, and export all threat assessments conducted on this device.
en.searchHistoryPlaceholder: Search history by keyword, category, or domain...
en.privacySubtitle: Understand how your data is protected and manage your local configuration.
en.dataStorageLocalDesc: All cases, evidence previews, and investigation histories are stored exclusively in your browser's local IndexedDB database. CyberShield AI does NOT maintain a user database or central file storage.
en.cloudAnalysisNoticeDesc: When you trigger an investigation, your selected evidence (text, image, audio, or video) is securely transmitted to Google Gemini API servers strictly to perform threat inference in accordance with Google API terms of service.
en.apiKeyDesc: Configure your own Google Gemini API key for analysis. It is stored locally in your browser and never logged on our servers.
en.enterApiKeyPlaceholder: Enter your Google Gemini API key...
en.clearAllLocalDataBtn: Clear All Local Data (Cases, History, Keys)
en.clearConfirmText: Are you sure you want to delete all local cases, evidence cache, history, and stored API keys? This action cannot be undone.
en.exportSubtitle: Download a clean, shareable cybersecurity incident dossier for law enforcement, IT security, or personal records.
